executive_summary: The agent's patch partially addresses the external SDK token flow issue by removing payment attempt dependencies in session construction and vault flows. However, it introduces a critical design flaw by wrapping payment attempts in Option without updating the underlying ConnectorSpecifications trait or any connector implementations, leaving the root cause unaddressed. The patch also introduces a behavioral discrepancy in payment_method_type handling compared to the gold patch.

approach_analysis.explanation: The agent took a fundamentally different and inferior approach. Instead of modifying the ConnectorSpecifications trait to make the PaymentAttempt parameter v1-only (as the gold patch does across 13 files), the agent locally wraps the parameter in Option<>. This is a workaround, not a fix. The trait and all 10+ connector implementations still unconditionally require &PaymentAttempt. When the v2 confirm flow eventually needs connector customer creation, the underlying connectors will still demand payment attempt data. The gold patch correctly gates the parameter with #[cfg(feature = "v1")] and provides v2-specific dispatch logic in connector_integration_interface.rs.

breaking_changes.description: Changed v2 should_call_connector_create_customer signature from &PaymentAttempt to Option<&PaymentAttempt>

issues.issue: Unconditionally wraps payment_data.get_payment_attempt() in Some(), defeating the purpose of making the parameter optional. If this function is called in a pre-confirm flow without a payment attempt, this will still fail.
issues.evidence: Line 7570: Some(payment_data.get_payment_attempt()) - the Option wrapper is pointless here since the inner code still calls .get_payment_attempt() directly. The gold patch removes this parameter entirely.

issues.issue: Sets payment_method_type to None in RouterData instead of Some(GooglePay) as in gold patch, potentially breaking downstream logic that expects a concrete payment method type for SDK sessions.
issues.evidence: Line 1382: payment_method_type (which equals None from destructuring), vs gold patch: payment_method_type: Some(enums::PaymentMethodType::GooglePay)

issues.issue: The Option-wrapping approach is a leaky abstraction. The trait ConnectorSpecifications::should_call_connector_customer still requires &PaymentAttempt unconditionally, so the Option handling is purely local and doesn't solve the architectural problem.
issues.evidence: Lines 118-120: payment_attempt.map(|attempt| connector.connector.should_call_connector_customer(attempt)).unwrap_or(false) - unwrap_or(false) means connectors that NEED customer creation won't get it when payment_attempt is None, even though the task says 'connectors requiring customer creation still function correctly when the flow reaches the confirm stage'

issues.issue: Removed None arm of match connector_name without considering if get_connector_name_as_string could ever return empty or invalid string. Previously None was handled gracefully.
issues.evidence: Removed: match connector_name { Some(connector_name) => {...} None => Ok(None) }

praised_patterns.observation: Correctly replaced payment_data.get_payment_attempt().connector.clone() with merchant_connector_account.get_connector_name_as_string() to remove payment attempt dependency for connector name resolution.
Correctly removed payment attempt dependency from SDK session data construction by setting payment_method and payment_method_type to None in the request.
praised_patterns.evidence: Lines 1333, 1363-1364: let (payment_method, payment_method_type) = (None, None); followed by payment_method, payment_method_type in request

praised_patterns.observation: Correctly passes None for payment_attempt in the external SDK token flow where no payment attempt exists yet.

issues_found.convention: Incomplete trait refactoring - local workaround without updating trait definitions
issues_found.evidence: Modified only the v2 wrapper function signature but left hyperswitch_interfaces/src/api.rs and all connector implementations unchanged, creating inconsistency where the outer API accepts Option but inner trait requires reference.
Both removed payment attempt extraction AND changed payment_method_type assignment behavior in same hunk.

praise_worthy_patterns.pattern: Simplified nested match structure in payments.rs by removing unnecessary Option handling when switching from Option<String> to String for connector_name.
praise_worthy_patterns.evidence: Removed 4 levels of indentation by eliminating match connector_name { Some(...) => {...} None => Ok(None) } wrapper.
